rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=5, train_n=400, n_iter=60, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.003, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=iter-18 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: pretrain_epochs 2->5 (richer warm-start init), on CHAMPION base (warm_start=True, img_sr=0.0002, lr=3e-3, n_iter=60; iter-15 hr=0.2056). warm_start REVERTED to True (iter-17 warm_start=False CRASHED to hr=0.0025, SSIM0.908 -> the warm-start pre-pass is ESSENTIAL: without a generic BF-sigma seed the 60-step per-scene fit from raw CONFIG init does not converge). HYPOTHESIS: since the warm-start init is CRITICAL, a BETTER init should help -- 5 warm-start epochs (vs 2) on the 400 train scenes give the generic BF sigmas more time to settle near the breast-optimal edge-preserving values, so each per-scene fit STARTS closer to its optimum and converges better in 60 steps -> hr above 0.2056. If FLAT/DROP, 2 warm-start epochs already saturate the generic init (the tiny 6-param BF learns its generic sigmas fast) and warm-start DEPTH is neutral -> 2 epochs is the efficient choice. WALL: pretrain 2->5 adds ~3x400=1200 warm steps ~ +90s; n_iter60 per-scene unchanged; outer_wall_s=1000, expect val_n~196-200 (report it). ONE knob: pretrain_epochs 2->5.
